buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 8. tion shall be submitted. 2 Prescribed EMD shall be submitted as per bid requirement. Original hard copy shall reach the Buyer offic e before Technical Bid opening, wherever applicable. 3 Valid OEM / Manufacturer / Brand / Authorized Distributor authorization for the offered product shall be u ploaded. 4 The quoted price must cover supply, delivery, on-site installation which includes wiring cutting of wall, plastering, provisioning of MCBS/Switches and grouting including plumbing and drainage wor ks as per site requirement ensuring the existing aesthetic of the building (internally and externally ) not get disturbed. If at all any B&R E&M Work is required to be executed for the operational reas on then after the installation and testing the site to be brought back into the original state, testing, commissioning. 5 Exact make/model, point-wise compliance sheet and supporting OEM datasheet/catalogue shall be uploa ded. 6 Past performance in Central/State Government or PSU sector shall be supported by satisfactory perform ance certificates. Manufacturer bidders shall submit applicable UDYAM / Factories Registration proof; non manufacturers shall submit valid OEM authorization. B. TECHNICAL, INSTALLATION, WARRANTY & PRICE C ONDITIONS 7 Quoted price shall include freight, loading/unloading, insurance, installation, testing, commissioning, sta ndard accessories, training and required electrical, plumbing and civil works. No extra installation charges shall be payable; disturbed areas shall be restored. 8 Supply shall be complete only after successful installation, testing, commissioning, demonstration and a cceptance by the consignee. Basic operation and maintenance training shall be provided without extra cos t. 9 Where bidder-declared specifications differ from OEM documentation, OEM technical documentation shal l prevail. Material misrepresentation may lead to rejection. C. ADDITIONAL BID-SPECIFIC CERTIFICATES & S ERVICE CONDITIONS 10 Dedicated / toll-free telephone number for service support shall be provided. Bidder / OEM must have a dedicated telephone number for service support. 11 Bidder / OEM shall provide an Escalation Matrix for Service Support with relevant contact details. 12 Bidder's offer shall be liable to rejection if any certificate / document sought in the Bid Document, ATC or Corrigendum, if any, is not uploaded. 13 Bidder shall have a service centre in the name of the firm within the city limit so that service can be pro vided without delay. Documentary proof shall be uploaded. 14 Solvency Certificate of Rs. 25 Lakh value shall be submitted. 15 Material Test Certificate shall be uploaded and shall also be sent along with the supply. Material may b e checked by the Buyer's laboratory and the laboratory results shall be the sole criteria for acceptance of t he item. 16 Bidder shall upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification of the Bid Document, wherever applicable. 17 Warranty Declaration shall be uploaded. 18 OEM shall ensure availability of spare parts for a minimum period of 5 years. Declaration from OEM shal l be enclosed. 19 Bidder shall have positive PAT for the last 3 consecutive financial years and submit CA-certified 3-year A verage Annual Turnover Certificate with valid UDIN and ITRs for the last 3 financial years. .
